waves-2027.title: Announcing: WAVES OF CHANGE 2027- Mahjong at Sea!
waves-2027.meta_desc: The Waves of Change Mahjong cruise is less about competition and more about connection: creating an environment where people bond over shared tables, shared stories, and shared purpose—while raising meaningful support for Love N People’s mission through a memorable, inclusive environment where everyone — from first-timers to lifelong players — can enjoy the rhythm and beauty of Mahjong at sea.Learn more and sign up at Let’s Play Mahjong cruise.

December 11th 2025 we launched our first category for financial relief and January 5th 2026 we have moved to phase two with our secondary category. market-2026.title: Heart & Heritage Market 2026
market-2026.meta_desc: Join us Feb 7th, 2026, in downtown Bristol for our first vendor event! Applications are open email jazmin@lovenpeople.org to register. Vendors are also supporting Love N People charity as proceeds go to our 2026 initiatives. Help us celebrate a historical landmark for our region from the 1900s, the old H.P. King Department Store & travel back to relive the glorious shopping days here. Come for the shopping, stay for the history, and leave knowing you’ve given back to your community.

over-the-edge.title: In 2020 Love'n'People was able to exceed the expected goal of $1500 for donation to the
over-the-edge.meta_desc: YWCA Northeast Tennessee and Southwest Virginia and Speedway Children's Charities - Bristol Motor Speedway through a partnership with Over The Edge. CEO Jazmin Hurley went "Over the Edge" at the Bristol Race Track afterwards.

santa-pal.title: Love N People was just awarded with the “Peg Brown Spirit of Santa Pal Award"
santa-pal.meta_desc: Love N People was just awarded with the “Peg Brown Spirit of Santa Pal Award" in 2019 which was presented in front of the Tennessee High Softball team who as a group was very active in community involvement. The years prior through partnerships with Santa Pal and other sponsors, Love'n'People has been able to supply more than 100's of kids and their families spreading the love of God through Christmas time.
